title: 2021 Fall AMC 12B Problem 9
statement: Triangle \(ABC\) is equilateral with side length \(6.\) Suppose that \(O\) is the center of the inscribed circle of this triangle. What is the area of the circle passing through \(A,\) \(O,\) and \(C?\)

solutions.text:
For an equilateral triangle, \(O\) is also the circumcenter, so \(OA = OC = \dfrac{6}{\sqrt3} = 2\sqrt3.\) The central angle \(\angle AOC = 120^\circ.\)

In triangle \(AOC,\) side \(AC = 6\) is opposite the \(120^\circ\) angle, so the circumradius \(R'\) of this triangle satisfies \[2R' = \dfrac{6}{\sin 120^\circ} = 4\sqrt3,\] giving \(R' = 2\sqrt3.\)

The area of the circle is \(\pi (2\sqrt3)^2 = 12\pi.\)

Thus, the correct answer is B.
hints: In an equilateral triangle the incenter coincides with the circumcenter
In triangle \(AOC,\) angle \(AOC = 120^\circ\) and \(AC = 6\); apply the law of sines
